name: imagemagick
description: Comprehensive image processing suite for creation, editing, conversion, and analysis of images

magick.description: Primary ImageMagick tool for image conversion, editing, and manipulation with extensive format support
magick.usage:
magick input.jpg -resize 50% output.jpg # Resize image to 50%
magick input.png -rotate 90 -flip rotated.png # Rotate 90° and flip
magick input.jpg -blur 0x3 -enhance blurred.jpg # Apply blur and enhance
magick -size 800x600 canvas:white -pointsize 72 -annotate +50+300 'Hello' text.png # Create text image
magick *.jpg -append vertical.jpg # Combine images vertically
magick input.jpg -colorspace Gray -threshold 50% bw.jpg # Convert to black and white

identify.description: Image format identification and metadata analysis tool with detailed technical information
identify.usage:
identify image.jpg # Show basic image information
identify -verbose image.png # Detailed metadata and properties
identify -format '%wx%h %m' *.jpg # Custom format output for multiple files
identify -ping large_file.tif # Quick info without loading full image

mogrify.description: Batch image transformation tool that modifies files in-place with powerful processing capabilities
mogrify.usage:
mogrify -resize 800x600 *.jpg # Resize all JPEG files in directory
mogrify -format png *.gif # Convert all GIF files to PNG
mogrify -quality 85 -strip *.jpg # Optimize JPEG quality and remove metadata
mogrify -rotate 90 -path ./rotated/ *.png # Rotate and save to different directory

compare.description: Image comparison tool for detecting differences and generating visual comparison reports
compare.usage:
compare image1.jpg image2.jpg diff.png # Create visual difference image
compare -metric RMSE image1.png image2.png null: # Get numerical difference score
compare -highlight-color red image1.jpg image2.jpg highlighted.jpg # Highlight differences in red
compare -fuzz 10% similar1.jpg similar2.jpg difference.png # Compare with 10% tolerance

composite.description: Image composition tool for layering, blending, and combining multiple images with various operators
composite.usage:
composite overlay.png background.jpg result.jpg # Overlay image on background
composite -blend 50 image1.jpg image2.jpg blended.jpg # Blend two images at 50%
composite -gravity center watermark.png photo.jpg marked.jpg # Center watermark on photo
composite -compose multiply mask.png image.jpg masked.jpg # Apply mask with multiply blend

montage.description: Image montage creator for generating collages, contact sheets, and multi-image layouts
montage.usage:
montage *.jpg -geometry 200x200+5+5 -tile 4x3 collage.jpg # Create 4x3 grid collage
montage photos/*.png -background white -geometry +10+10 contact.jpg # Contact sheet with spacing
montage -label '%f' *.jpg -frame 5 -geometry 150x150 labeled.jpg # Add filenames as labels
montage image*.jpg -mode concatenate strip.jpg # Horizontal strip layout

conjure.description: ImageMagick scripting interpreter for executing MSL (Magick Scripting Language) batch operations
conjure.usage:
conjure script.msl # Execute ImageMagick script file
conjure -debug all script.msl # Run script with detailed debugging output
conjure -verbose operations.msl # Execute with verbose progress information

stream.description: Streaming image processor for handling large images and pixel-level operations efficiently
stream.usage:
stream -map rgb input.jpg output.txt # Extract RGB pixel values as text
stream -storage-type char input.png rgb.raw # Export raw pixel data
stream -extract 100x100+50+50 large.tif crop.rgb # Extract region as raw data
stream -map i input.jpg gray.txt # Extract intensity values
